description: GTEx quantification of SERPINA6 tissue expression vs SERPINA1 and ALB
code:
"""
Where is SERPINA6 expressed? Quantitative tissue expression from GTEx v8 bulk RNA-seq.
Tests the claim 'synthesized in liver' and quantifies extrahepatic expression.
"""
import requests, numpy as np, pandas as pd, matplotlib.pyplot as plt

base="https://gtexportal.org/api/v2"
# resolve gene
g=requests.get(f"{base}/reference/gene", params={"geneId":"SERPINA6","format":"json"}, timeout=90).json()
rows=g.get("data", g.get("gene", []))
print("Gene lookup:", [(r["geneSymbol"], r["gencodeId"], r.get("chromosome"), r.get("description","")[:60]) for r in rows][:5])
gid=[r["gencodeId"] for r in rows if r["geneSymbol"]=="SERPINA6"][0]
print("Using gencodeId:", gid)

def median_expr(gencode):
    out=[]; page=0
    while True:
        r=requests.get(f"{base}/expression/medianGeneExpression",
                       params={"gencodeId":gencode,"datasetId":"gtex_v8","page":page,"itemsPerPage":250},
                       timeout=90).json()
        out += r["data"]
        if page >= r["paging_info"]["numberOfPages"]-1: break
        page+=1
    return pd.DataFrame(out)

df = median_expr(gid)[["tissueSiteDetailId","median"]].rename(columns={"median":"TPM"})
df = df.sort_values("TPM", ascending=False).reset_index(drop=True)
tot = df["TPM"].sum()
print(f"\nSERPINA6 median expression across {len(df)} GTEx tissues (TPM)")
print(df.head(15).to_string(index=False))
print(f"\nLiver TPM = {df.loc[df.tissueSiteDetailId=='Liver','TPM'].iloc[0]:.1f}")
liv=df.loc[df.tissueSiteDetailId=='Liver','TPM'].iloc[0]
second=df.iloc[1]
print(f"Top non-liver tissue: {second.tissueSiteDetailId} = {second.TPM:.2f} TPM")
print(f"Liver / next-highest ratio = {liv/max(second.TPM,1e-9):.0f}-fold")
print(f"Liver share of summed median TPM across tissues = {100*liv/tot:.1f}%")
print(f"Tissues with TPM >= 1: {(df.TPM>=1).sum()}  |  TPM < 0.5: {(df.TPM<0.5).sum()}")

# Comparator: SERPINA1 (same locus, also hepatic) and ALB
comp={}
for sym in ["SERPINA1","ALB"]:
    rr=requests.get(f"{base}/reference/gene", params={"geneId":sym,"format":"json"}, timeout=90).json()
    rws=rr.get("data", rr.get("gene",[]))
    gg=[x["gencodeId"] for x in rws if x["geneSymbol"]==sym][0]
    d=median_expr(gg)[["tissueSiteDetailId","median"]].rename(columns={"median":"TPM"})
    comp[sym]=d.set_index("tissueSiteDetailId")["TPM"]
    l=comp[sym].get("Liver",np.nan); s=comp[sym].drop("Liver").max()
    print(f"  {sym}: Liver {l:.0f} TPM, next-highest {s:.1f} TPM, ratio {l/max(s,1e-9):.0f}-fold")

fig,(ax1,ax2)=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(14,6.2),gridspec_kw={'width_ratios':[1.5,1]})
top=df.head(20).iloc[::-1]
cols=['#c0392b' if t=='Liver' else '#7f8c8d' for t in top.tissueSiteDetailId]
ax1.barh(range(len(top)), top.TPM, color=cols)
ax1.set_yticks(range(len(top))); ax1.set_yticklabels(top.tissueSiteDetailId, fontsize=8.5)
ax1.set_xscale('log'); ax1.set_xlabel("Median TPM (GTEx v8, log scale)")
ax1.set_title("SERPINA6 is a liver gene\ntop 20 of %d GTEx tissues" % len(df))
for i,(v,t) in enumerate(zip(top.TPM, top.tissueSiteDetailId)):
    ax1.text(v*1.15, i, f"{v:.2f}" if v<10 else f"{v:.0f}", va='center', fontsize=7.5)
ser6=df.set_index("tissueSiteDetailId")["TPM"]
share=pd.DataFrame({"SERPINA6":ser6,"SERPINA1":comp["SERPINA1"],"ALB":comp["ALB"]})
r=[100*share[c].get("Liver",np.nan)/share[c].sum() for c in share.columns]
ax2.bar(share.columns, r, color=['#c0392b','#2980b9','#27ae60'])
ax2.set_ylabel("Liver share of summed median TPM (%)")
ax2.set_title("Hepatic restriction compared with\ntwo other plasma proteins")
for i,v in enumerate(r): ax2.text(i, v+1.5, f"{v:.1f}%", ha='center', fontsize=10)
ax2.set_ylim(0,105)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
